findings.evidence: The r6 snapshot claims a v1.4.506 sealed-package pass and a real Electron build that passed the new credential guard, but the carried evidence note still describes a v1.4.505 build at commit b2a7d5015f0dcec2a7a3540d83189c123e022f87 and the current release receipt still records version 1.4.505. Current release/latest-linux.yml is 1.4.506, so the snapshot is binding current artifacts to stale proof.
findings.scope: release acceptance items sealed-updater-contract and transient-credential-validation
findings.remediation: Regenerate and bind fresh v1.4.506 build evidence: a current receipt or equivalent artifact proving the exact v1.4.506 build, plus a current validator/build artifact showing validate-electron-package and validate-electron-vite-env passed against this candidate.

remaining_risks: Public updater read-back is still unproven in this review scope; no live fetch evidence is bound for the published v1.4.506 manifest and artifact.
Installed desktop retry remains unproven in this review scope; no installed-app evidence shows a failed-marker retry downloading, relaunching, and reporting v1.4.506.

reviewer.isolation_evidence: Inspected only the supplied r6 snapshot plus the bounded local source, tests, and release artifacts needed to evaluate its acceptance items: scripts/validate-electron-vite-env.cjs, tests/unit/scripts/validate-electron-vite-env.test.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, electron/updater.ts, scripts/validate-electron-package.cjs, tests/unit/scripts/validate-electron-package.test.ts, tests/unit/electron/appimage-installer-transaction-runtime.test.ts, tests/unit/electron-appimage-installer.test.ts, tests/unit/electron/updater-auth-durability.test.ts, tests/unit/electron/updater-pending.test.ts, docs/challenge/evidence-2026-09-02-bug-2071-release.md, release/latest-linux.yml, release/linux-unpacked/resources/app.asar, and release/flowstate-release-receipt.json. Ran no tests and made no code changes.

evidence.result: The bounded direct-installer runtime fixture still verifies the direct replacement path, accepts the exact multi-line whitespace-formatted provenance payload for the target version, and rolls back when provenance reports a stale version.

The bounded updater retry suite still proves explicit retry clears only the blocked marker for the running version, performs a fresh update check, and redownloads the exact blocked update; the paired pending-update suite remains present for cleanup coverage.

The source and regression test for the sealed updater contract are still present, but the only bound runtime/build evidence in scope still describes a v1.4.505 package-validation pass, not the r6 candidate's claimed v1.4.506 sealed-package validation.

The new validator source and regression test cover 429-then-200 success, persistent 429 failure, 401 failure, and secret redaction, but no fresh runtime artifact proves the real Electron build executed that guard for v1.4.506; the available release receipt is still for v1.4.505.
